result: Heavy congestion observed during peak hours due to lane closure. Recommend scheduling closure during night time.

post_incident_report.lessons_learned: Daytime lane closures on this corridor cause cascading delays to Sanga and Alt routes. Night-time (22:00-05:00) closures had minimal impact in a follow-up test.
post_incident_report.what_failed: Traffic police were deployed 30 minutes late. Public notice was not issued in time.
post_incident_report.what_worked: Alternative route signage at Suryabinayak junction was effective. Radio announcements reached ~60% of commuters.

result: Complete closure resulted in 4-hour detour delays. Bailey bridge deployment is strictly required for future repairs of this scale.

post_incident_report.lessons_learned: Full bridge closure without Bailey bridge alternative is catastrophic for the corridor. Pre-deploy Bailey bridge 48 hours before planned closure.
post_incident_report.what_failed: No alternative crossing was prepared. Emergency vehicles had to use the Arniko Highway detour adding 4+ hours.
post_incident_report.what_worked: Nepal Army engineers deployed Bailey bridge on Day 2. After deployment, delays dropped to 45 minutes.

result: Complete road blockage after 140mm rainfall in 6 hours. Earth movers took 14 hours to clear.

post_incident_report.lessons_learned: Sanga Hill section is the highest-risk landslide zone. Rainfall above 100mm/day should trigger preventive closure and pre-positioned earth movers.
post_incident_report.what_failed: No early warning. Vehicles were trapped for 6 hours. One medical emergency required helicopter evacuation.
post_incident_report.what_worked: Post-event, Nepal Police checkpoint at Jagati prevented additional vehicles from entering the blocked zone.

result: 48-tonne cement truck exceeded 35-tonne limit. Bridge temporarily closed for emergency inspection. Hairline cracks found in pier cap.

post_incident_report.lessons_learned: Weighbridge at Banepa entry must be operational 24/7. Current night-time gap allows overloaded trucks through.
post_incident_report.what_failed: Weighbridge was unmanned between 22:00-06:00. Bridge inspection delayed by 2 hours due to unavailable engineer.
post_incident_report.what_worked: Quick diversion to Alt Route 1 limited delays. SMS alert system reached 850 subscribed drivers within 5 minutes.

result: River overflow flooded 200m of road. Water depth reached 0.8m. All traffic halted.

post_incident_report.lessons_learned: When Sunkoshi river level exceeds 'Warning' threshold, close Jagati low section preemptively. Build raised causeway.
post_incident_report.what_failed: No river level monitoring integration. Road was still open when water started rising. 12 vehicles stranded.
post_incident_report.what_worked: Fire brigade pumps cleared water in 4 hours after rain stopped. Community volunteers assisted with traffic management.

result: Night closure (23:00-05:00) for road resurfacing. Minimal traffic impact. Only 3% increase in alt route travel time.

post_incident_report.lessons_learned: Night closures between 23:00-05:00 are ideal for maintenance. Traffic volume drops to <5% of peak. Ambulance routes remain viable via Alt 1.
post_incident_report.what_failed: Nothing significant. Minor noise complaints from nearby residents.
post_incident_report.what_worked: Pre-notification via SMS 48 hours ahead. Police escort for emergency vehicles. Work completed 30 minutes ahead of schedule.
